Take your sales career to new heights in aviation technology!
About Flygprestanda
Since 1969, Flygprestanda AB has been at the forefront of aviation performance technology. With decades of industry expertise, we develop innovative Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that help airlines and aircraft operators worldwide perform safe and efficient takeoff and landing performance calculations.
Based in central Malmö, we combine deep aviation knowledge with cutting-edge technology to deliver solutions that make a real difference in aviation safety.
Now, we're looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Representative to join our close-knit Sales & Marketing team and help us reach new heights.

The opportunity
Are you a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships, discovering new business opportunities, and turning conversations into successful partnerships? Are you curious about technology and excited by the prospect of working with customers around the world?
As our Sales Representative, you'll play a key role in driving growth and expanding our international customer base. You'll connect with prospective and existing customers, present innovative software solutions, and help airlines and aircraft operators discover how our technology can support their operations.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll combine proactive sales, customer engagement, online product demonstrations, and account management. You'll also work closely with colleagues across engineering, software development, finance, and marketing, gaining valuable insight into both our products and the aviation industry.
What you'll be doing
Create new business opportunities by following up on inbound leads and reaching out to prospective and existing customers through calls and emails.
Build lasting customer relationships by understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities, and providing a professional, responsive experience.
Drive sales forward by preparing commercial proposals, negotiating offers, and closing deals to achieve sales targets.
Showcase our technology by delivering engaging online demonstrations that bring the benefits of our software to life.
Support our customers and sales pipeline through account administration and accurate maintenance of customer and prospect databases.
Discover new opportunities through market research, industry insights, and competitor analysis.
Collaborate across teams to ensure a smooth customer journey, from the first conversation to a successful partnership.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and motivated by results. You enjoy taking initiative, communicating with people, and finding solutions that create value for customers.
You don't shy away from picking up the phone, following up on opportunities, or starting conversations with new prospects. You're equally comfortable working independently and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
You may already have experience in sales, or you may be ready to take the next step in your commercial career. An interest in technology, digital solutions, or aviation would be a great advantage.
You'll bring:
Previous sales experience and a genuine interest in developing new business.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with international customers.
Strong listening and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
Experience using CRM systems and MS Office or LibreOffice.
The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and organize your working day.
A structured, thorough, and solution-oriented approach to your work.
A positive team spirit and a professional attitude.

Experience in the aviation industry and a degree in business or a related field are advantageous, but not essential. Some international travel may be required.
Why join Flygprestanda?
International reach: Work with airlines and aircraft operators across the world.
Meaningful technology: Represent software solutions that contribute to safe aviation operations.
A varied role: Combine sales, customer relationships, technology, and market development.
A collaborative environment: Work closely with knowledgeable colleagues across multiple disciplines.
A strong industry foundation: Join a company with a long history of aviation expertise and a forward-looking approach to technology.

Practical information
Location: Central Malmö, Sweden
Salary: Starting from SEK 34,000 per month
Travel: Some international travel may be required
Ready for takeoff?
If you're driven by sales, enjoy building international relationships, and want to work at the intersection of technology and aviation, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your CV and personal letter to **careers@flygp.se** not later than 28/11-2026.
Questions about the role? Contact Åke Grundemar at 040-642 00 26 or 0765-262 626, or email quality@flygp.se.
Note: This position may be appointed prior to above stated deadline.

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our open-minded team where collaboration and support are at the heart of what we do! In this dynamic role, you will engage in the design of steel structures and installation solutions, producing manufacturing data in NX along with essential technical documentation. You will have the chance to participate in R&D projects, tackling a variety of assignments that will deepen your understanding of installation topics. As you interact with both internal and external interfaces, you will expand your professional network and pave the way for future opportunities, potentially stepping into a coordinating role for mechanical installation resources in our development projects.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Design innovative steel structures and installation solutions while producing manufacturing data in NX and associated technical documentation.
Participate in the development and maintenance of product standards, ensuring technical solutions are cost-effective and of high quality.
Collaborate with procurement and sub-suppliers to develop robust technical solutions, addressing generic issues and conducting root cause analyses.
Engage with other package systems and contribute to the overall design philosophy of our gas turbine packages.
Work closely with the project team to ensure design work aligns with the current schedule, creating, reviewing, and updating documentation within your technical area.

What You Bring
MSc or BSc in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent knowledge/experience.
Strong understanding of applicable norms and standards in process and mechanical engineering, particularly PED and ASME.
Proficient in English, with Swedish language skills considered a plus.
A passion for technology and a desire to learn in a multicultural environment.
Excellent teamwork skills, with a structured, driven approach to prioritizing and organizing your work effectively.
A proactive mindset focused on finding solutions and taking ownership of your tasks.

About the Team
The Structure & Layout team consists of 19 skilled engineers specializing in structural engineering and layout design for complex energy projects. Organized into two collaborative teams, we foster a close-knit and supportive work environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual support are key to our success. We place a strong emphasis on personal and professional development, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to grow. This commitment to quality and continuous improvement creates a culture where individuals thrive while delivering high-quality solutions.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Want to take over the technical leadership of a Nordic market leader? Skip the corporate bureaucracy, drive next-generation structural engineering, and build the new product portfolio for the infrastructure that will support the global transition to 6G. Today Cue Dee are a leading supplier to leading mobile operators, TowerCo (Tower Company) and system integrators in Europe.

This recruitment is conducted in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. However, you will be employed directly by CUE DEE AB.

Cue Dee is the Nordic market leader in telecom infrastructure solutions, with a strong market presence and office in Stockholm, Umeå and Gdansk. Backed by the stable Lagercrantz Group, we combine 45+ years of heritage with global industrial manufacturing-and we are gearing up to celebrate our 50th anniversary in 2028. We develop and sell specific steel and aluminum structures used at telecom sites and rooftops worldwide.

We design, develop, and supply optimized steel and aluminum structures, both standard and customized, for telecom sites and rooftop applications worldwide.

Within 6-12 months, you will fully take over the function, join the Management Team, report directly to the CEO, and take on formal responsibility for your own team of senior and junior designers.

 This role is heavily weighted toward structural technology and design, giving you the mandate to shape our technical roadmap as the world prepares for the implementation of 6G.

 
Design for Manufacture: Drive mechanical and structural product development from raw requirements to market-ready products. You ensure that what you and the team design can be manufactured efficiently.

You need to be business driven and open to meeting and understanding customers to industrialize the customer needs into our new product portfolio.
Presence & Travel: Your base is in Kista, but you will visit our other office outside Umeå and our team in Poland. Travel is primarily within Sweden and Europe (approx. 15-20 days per year) to meet customers, production teams, and suppliers.

 

 Who You Are
 You are a sharp mechanical engineer with leadership experience who wants to make a real business impact. Telecom industry experience is welcomed but not required for this role. We place great value on strong engineering expertise in areas such as structural design, mechanics, and materials engineering. At the same time, we believe that experience from other industries can bring fresh perspectives, innovative ideas, and valuable expertise that strengthen our team and drive continuous improvement.
Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and coaching a smaller group of engineers or product developers.
The Foundation: A relevant technical degree or engineering background, combined with a solid track record in mechanical product development and manufacturing.
The Tech & Material Edge: Knowledge in structural design and in materials, manufacturing methods, materials and particularly steel and aluminum.
Building/Structural Mindset: Since our products are installed in demanding environments (often on existing building rooftops), a solid understanding of structural engineering, load-bearing structures, or building technology is an advantage.
The Mindset: Accountable, pragmatic, and business-minded. You avoid unnecessary overengineering and focus on safety, compliance, cost-efficiency, and manufacturability.
Language: Fluent English. Swedish is a strong asset.

Why Cue Dee?
 You get the financial backing of a powerhouse group, but the speed, impact, and entrepreneurial culture of an agile, market-leading 30-person company.

Short decision-making paths, real product ownership, and direct interaction with the CEO enable you to take ideas from concept to finished product with speed and impact.

Are you a hands-on research scientist with deep expertise in medical imaging and strong technical skills in programming, data analytics and AI?

Do you enjoy combining scientific research with practical technical development, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?

Collective Minds is looking for a Research Scientist to drive scientific and technical contributions in public and private research consortia. This is an opportunity to combine research, technology and project ownership in a growing international healthtech company.

About Collective Minds
Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.

About the role
As Research Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise in medical imaging with hands-on technical development and ownership of selected research consortia.
Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.

Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research.
Your main responsibilities:
Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
Develop and implement technical solutions, including scripts, data pipelines, analytical tools, dashboards and AI-based applications.
Make scientific and technical decisions across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.
Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
Manage project scope and stakeholder expectations, clearly defining deliverables and commitments.
Take ownership of work package delivery, reporting to consortium partners, coordinators and funders, and efficient project close-outs.
Collaborate with internal teams and external research partners, coordinating additional resources when needed.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a scientifically experienced and technically skilled professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with the ability to independently develop solutions and deliver complex research projects.
You are analytical, pragmatic and hands-on, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and driving results in a fast-moving environment.

We believe you have:
A strong scientific background in life sciences, medicine, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.
Strong hands-on technical skills in Python, SQL, DICOM and AI frameworks, with experience developing scripts, data tools and analytical solutions. Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Superset or Metabase is a plus.
Experience delivering work packages in research consortia or grant-funded projects, including grant execution, reporting and project close-outs.
A proven ability to independently manage research projects within agreed budgets, timelines and scope, and make informed scientific and technical decisions.
Experience coordinating work across academic, clinical and industry partners, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel internationally as required, typically approximately every two months.
Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.

Why join Collective Minds?
At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.
You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.
This is an opportunity to work with leading scientific and industry partners, contribute to innovative research collaborations and play an important role in the continued growth of an international healthtech company.

Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – Expert
Integro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | Sweden
Help shape the future of sustainable powertrain technology
Integro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.
This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.
Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.
About the assignment
You will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).
You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.
Key responsibilities
Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.

Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.

Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.

Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.

Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.

Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.

Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.

Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.

Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.

Required qualifications and experience
We are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.
You should have:
An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.

Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.

Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.

Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.

Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.

Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.

Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.

Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.

Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.

Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.

You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.
Meritorious experience
The following would be particularly valuable:
Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.

 Thesis Scope & Problem Statement 
This thesis project is intended for two Master's students working together.
 The central focus of this Master's thesis is to design, implement, and evaluate a confidence-aware adaptiverification architecture within the existing annotation tool. Instead of applying the same review process every detection or scene, the system will use confidence signals to select an appropriate depth of humverification. This is a software engineering thesis focused on how to structure, integrate, test, and evaluathat adaptive behavior, with particular attention to maintainability, traceability, fallback behavior, andeffective human oversight. Existing AI models provide the application context; developing new perceptimodels is not the primary objective.
 Research Objectives & Tasks
  
 The work may include:
  Design and integrate a modular architecture with explicit interfaces for confidence providerverification policies, decision logging, and annotator feedbac
 Implement confidence-provider components that expose calibrated or normalized signals, such model confidence, model agreement, source model, and object class frequency, through a comminterface.
 Implement and compare interchangeable threshold-based and learned decision policies for routingcases to light review, full review, or a second review. Automatic acceptance will be considered onlywhere permitted by safety policy, with low-confidence, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical casrouted to human review.
 Integrate attention cues into the annotation interface and record the signals, policy version, selectedreview mode, and human outcome for each routing decision.
 Develop automated tests for routing decisions, component interfaces, and fallback behavior.
 Benchmark the adaptive architecture against existing manual, sequential, and parallel workflousing annotation correctness, recall on safety-critical classes, error catch rates, task completion time,routing overhead, and human intervention.
 Evaluate maintainability and testability through change scenarios, such as adding a confidenprovider or replacing a decision policy.
 Conduct a counterbalanced user study to investigate verification behavior, cognitive workload, trucalibration, and susceptibility to automation bias.
  
Depending on feasibility and measurable added value, the work may also explore out-of-distributiondetection or vision-language-model-derived scene complexity as additional confidence signals. The coevaluation will use fixed policies during controlled experiments; online adaptation is an optional extension.
 Who Are We?

 You should have a foundation in modular software design, interface design, automated testing, and versioncontrol, together with an interest in empirical software engineering. An interest inlearning enough about model confidence and human verification to make sound software design decisis important.
 Why Join Us? 
This thesis offers an opportunity to apply software engineering methods to a concrete industrial challengdesigning an adaptive human-AI workflow that is maintainable, testable, and auditable. You will build on existing annotation platform and prior thesis results, taking the work from architectural design throughimplementation and empirical evaluation.
 You will:

 Investigate how confidence signals can guide human attention while preserving traceability ahuman oversight.
 Measure architectural trade-offs across annotation correctness, performance, maintainabilittestability, and human effort.
 Collaborate with engineers working on the validation of autonomous transport solutions.
  
 
 You will gain practical experience in designing and evaluating human-AI systems in a safety-critical context.We look forward to receiving your application letter, academic transcript, and CV in English.

CERN's scientific mission relies on the exchange of knowledge, technologies and equipment across borders. Ensuring that these exchanges meet export-control requirements is essential to managing risks and enabling responsible research.

To support a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach to export-control compliance, CERN is establishing an internal compliance programme, centred on a new CERN Export Control Compliance Office.

As Export Control Compliance Lead, you will establish and lead the Export Control Compliance Office, developing the governance, policies and processes needed to embed this programme across the Organization.

Working within the Resilience team in OSI-ICS, you will conduct classifications, screenings, due diligence reviews, compliance assessments and export-control evaluations. You will provide expert advice to CERN Management on export-control and related regulatory risks, and work closely with legal, technical and operational experts to ensure effective implementation of export-control requirements.

This is an opportunity to shape a new compliance function at the intersection of science, advanced technology and international regulation.

Your responsibilities:
- Establish and lead CERN's Export Control Compliance Office, developing and implementing the governance framework, policies, processes, guidance, tools and training needed to support a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach to export-control compliance across the Organization.
- Act as CERN's central focal point for export-control compliance matters, advising personnel, promoting awareness, conducting classifications, screenings, end-user and end-use reviews, compliance assessments, determinations and other due diligence activities, and coordinating inputs as required.
- Support and monitor the operational implementation of export-control requirements and decisions, including the management of export authorisations and associated compliance measures; act as principal adviser and secretariat to the Export Control Compliance Committee and coordinate departmental export-control liaison officers.
- Serve as CERN's contact point on export-control matters with relevant national authorities, external advisers and peer organisations, and maintain an effective external network within the export-control compliance community, particularly in the research sector.
- Maintain authoritative records of export-control compliance assessments, determinations, authorisations, policies, procedures and supporting documentation, including registers of technologies, activities, institutions and persons subject to screening, due diligence or export-control requirements.
- Monitor the effectiveness of CERN's export-control compliance arrangements, identify emerging risks, issues and trends, support the management of incidents, and provide reporting, escalation and recommendations for their continual improvement.
- Carry out such other tasks as may be required to deliver an effective export-control compliance programme.
